It helps students integrate technical knowledge with ethical responsibility, sustainability, and human values, ensuring their work benefits both society and nature.

lq.ANSWER: Human beings can sustain harmony in nature by living with right understanding and responsibility. Practical steps include value education and awareness, value-based living, reducing unnecessary consumption, walking or cycling when possible, planting trees, reforestation, protecting wildlife and national parks, water harvesting, restoring wetlands, preserving rivers, sustainable agriculture, nurturing birds and animals, stopping poaching, reducing waste, recycling, reusing materials and using renewable energy. These actions must not be done only as isolated activities, but as expressions of right understanding. The aim is to preserve, protect and enrich nature while fulfilling genuine human needs. In this way, human beings can move from exploitation to mutual enrichment and participate in universal human order.
